paper_title: SRPO Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware   Reinforcement Learning
caption: Performance of various RL methods with and without self-reflection.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма илюстрира точността на различни методи за обучение с подсилване (RL) с и без саморефлексия в три различни области: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. По вертикалната ос, етикетирана като "Accuracy (%)", са показани стойностите на точност, вариращи от 50 до 62 процента с интервал от 2%. По хоризонталната ос са изброени трите категории: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics, които са подредени в азбучен ред. За всяка категория са представени шест стълба, съответстващи на следните методи: DAPO+Self-reflection (синьо), DAPO (сиво-синьо), SRPO (оранжево), GRPO (жълто-оранжево), PPO+Self-reflection (зелено) и PPO (светло зелено). Някои от стълбите са групирани заедно и визуално са разделени чрез различни шарки на щрихи. Най-високите стойности на точност са около 61% за Physics при използване на SRPO и DAPO+Self-reflection, а най-ниските са около 53% за Mathverse при PPO. Стълбите са подредени така, че да позволяват сравняване на методите с и без саморефлексия за всяка от трите категории. Всички стълби са оцветени според легендата и нямат допълнителни бележки или подчертавания.
model_annotations.Chinese: The graph presents a comparison of the performance of various reinforcement learning (RL) methods, with and without self-reflection, across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis lists these categories, while the vertical axis represents accuracy as a percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with increments of 2%. The graph features six types of bars, each representing a different RL method: DAPO+Self-reflection (blue), DAPO (light blue), SRPO (orange), GRPO (tan), PPO+Self-reflection (green), and PPO (light green). For Mathverse, the shortest bars are for DAPO and PPO, both approximately 53%, while the longest is DAPO+Self-reflection at around 56%. For MMLU, the bars are generally higher, with DAPO and PPO again being the shortest, around 55%, and DAPO+Self-reflection being the longest, approximately 57%. For Physics, the bars are significantly higher, with DAPO and PPO being the shortest, around 57%, and DAPO+Self-reflection being the longest, approximately 61%. The bars are grouped by method, with self-reflection methods generally appearing to have higher accuracy. There is no clear overall ordering of the categories, and no bars are visually emphasized.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the performance of various reinforcement learning methods with and without self-reflection across three domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled as Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, in that order, with no apparent scale or ordering. The vertical axis represents accuracy as a percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 50 to 62, marked at regular intervals of 2, and labeled "Accuracy (%)". The chart features grouped bars, with each group consisting of six bars representing different methods: DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO. The bars are colored blue, gray, orange, yellow, green, and teal, respectively. For Mathverse, the approximate values are 56, 53, 54, 53, 54, and 53; for MMLU, the values are 57, 56, 56, 56, 55, and 54; and for Physics, the values are 61, 58, 59, 58, 57, and 55. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The grouping is visually arranged to facilitate comparison between methods within each domain.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt die Leistung verschiedener Methoden des Reinforcement Learning (RL) mit und ohne Selbstreflexion über drei Datensätze hinweg: Mathverse, MMLU und Physics. Die horizontale Achse listet diese Datensätze auf, während die vertikale Achse die Genauigkeit in Prozenten misst, mit einem Wertebereich von 50 bis 62 und einer linearen Skala. Es werden sechs verschiedene Methoden verglichen, dargestellt durch Balken in unterschiedlichen Farben: DAPO+Self-reflection (blau), DAPO (grau), SRPO (orange), GRPO (gelb), PPO+Self-reflection (grün) und PPO (hellgrün). Im Datensatz Mathverse weisen die Methoden DAPO+Self-reflection, SRPO und GRPO die höchsten Werte auf. Im MMLU-Datensatz zeigen DAPO+Self-reflection und SRPO höhere Werte als die anderen Methoden. Im Physikdatensatz erreichen DAPO+Self-reflection, SRPO und PPO+Self-reflection die höchsten Werte. Die Balken sind nach den Datensätzen gruppiert und die Farben konsistent über alle Datensätze. Insbesondere stechen die Balken für DAPO+Self-reflection im Physikdatensatz und für SRPO im MMLU-Datensatz hervor. Die Anordnung der Balken erfolgt nicht in einer spezifischen Reihenfolge, außer dass die Methoden konsistent über die Datensätze hinweg dargestellt sind.
